chat.meta.title: ask troid
chat.meta.description: ask troid. troid's rule data with each rule's source and read date, arithmetic through tools, every number with its tier. Not financial advice.
chat.hero.lede:
ask troid answers from troid's rule data and its own arithmetic tools. It
  prices the trade you bring. It does not generate one.
chat.status.checking: checking whether the assistant is switched on…
chat.placeholder: e.g. Bitfunded 1-Step, $100k quota, equity 96,000, short 77,872 with a 0.3% stop — size it.
chat.nfa: Not financial advice. Verify with the firm before acting.
chat.is.p: A chat over TROID.md, the rules on troid's compare, the methodology and a fixed support script. Sizing, budgets and compliance checks run through tools that do the arithmetic and name the document and read date of every rule they use, or say its source is not yet recorded; the model reports what they return. Every number carries its tier. A pending rule stays pending.
chat.isnt.p:
A signal service, a firm recommendation, a memory of you, or a way to reach your account.
  troid stores nothing you type; the page keeps the conversation only while it is open. To
  answer, troid sends the conversation to the company that provides the AI model, which may
  keep it for a limited period under its own terms. troid's log records one line per message:
  answered or failed, tool calls, the model called, whether the reply was the abuse warning,
  the fixed reply given when the AI model declines to answer, or the end of the session, and an
  error's status code. Never the text, never your address. The hosting provider keeps its own
  request logs, which can include your IP address. About 20 messages an hour per address.
chat.discl: ask troid can be wrong; the firm's own documents govern. Verify with the firm before acting. Section 10 of troid's terms has the detail.
chat.js.full: This conversation has reached its limit of {n} questions. Reloading the page starts a new one.
chat.js.status_on: on · {firms}{limit} messages an hour · no memory between visits
chat.js.status_off: ask troid is built and switched off. It goes live once troid's terms and ask troid's guardrails have had legal review. Until then troid's desk on the front page does the arithmetic.
chat.js.unreachable: ask troid could not be reached.
chat.js.ended: This session has ended. Reloading the page starts a new one.
